reflections: v13-v16 preserve the ambitious GMUT and simulation vision, but this phase treats those statements as hypotheses and design history rather than external confirmation.
v24 and v45-v48 emphasize Freed ID, recourse, consent and the later correction from completed prophecy to truth-labeled roadmap; that correction directly motivates the allocation-authority gate.
v45-v48 frame Albion as a future bounded simulation habitat; this phase contributes only finite synthetic allocation certificates, not a world model or inhabited environment.
v49-v52 emphasize receipts, exact staging, exposure guards and remote equality; those operational lessons shape the source-faithful lifecycle without becoming independent validation.
boundary: Finite synthetic same-owner cooperative-game software and documentation evidence only; no real allocation, participant observation, independent reproduction, empirical GMUT confirmation, production THOS or Freed ID, professional, legal, cultural, affected-party or Maori authority, complete privacy, accessibility or security assurance, consciousness, personhood, Theory-of-Everything proof or Stage 20 readiness.
